[[5ban Graphics]] |type=Colorless |class=Special |provides={{e|Colorless}}, {{e|Grass}}, {{e|Fire}}, {{e|Psychic}}, or {{e|Darkness}} }} {{TCGEnergyCardInfobox/Expansion|type=Colorless|expansion={{TCG|Dragons Exalted}}|rarity={{rar|Uncommon}}|cardno=117/124|jpexpansion={{TCG|Dragon Blast}}|jprarity={{rar|U}}|jpcardno=050/050}} {{TCGEnergyCardInfobox/Expansion|type=Colorless|jphalfdeck={{TCG|Hydreigon Half Deck}}|jpcardno=015/015}} {{TCGEnergyCardInfobox/Expansion|type=Colorless|jpdeckkit={{TCG|Master Deck Build Box EX}}|jpcardno=045/046}} {{TCGEnergyCardInfobox/Expansion|type=Colorless|jphalfdeck={{TCG|Pokémon Card Game 25th Anniversary Creatures Deck}}}} {{TCGEnergyCardInfobox/Footer|type=Colorless}} '''Blend Energy {{e|Grass}}{{e|Fire}}{{e|Psychic}}{{e|Darkness}}''' (Japanese: '''ブレンドエネルギー 草炎超悪''' ''Blend Energy {{e|Grass}}{{e|Fire}}{{e|Psychic}}{{e|Darkness}}'') is a {{TCG|Special Energy card}}. It was first released as part of the {{TCG|Dragons Exalted}} expansion. ==Card text== {{Cardtext/Header|type=Colorless}} {{Cardtext/Energy |type=Colorless |effect=This card provides {{e|Colorless}} Energy. When this card is attached to a Pokémon, this card provides {{e|Grass}}, {{e|Fire}}, {{e|Psychic}}, or {{e|Darkness}} Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. }} {{Cardtext/Footer}} ===Back (Creatures Deck print)=== {{TCGTrainerText|effect= '''''[[Pokédex 3D Pro]]'''''
'''''[[Pokémon Dream Radar]]''''' ''Pokédex 3D Pro'' was developed as a database that allows you to view Pokémon and their official information on your [[Nintendo 3DS]]. You can view high quality 3D CG of Pokémon from any angle you like. "I created the models and motions for over 600 Pokémon from scratch, with the goal of maximizing the 3DS's graphical capabilities." ([[Atsuko Ujiie]]) (July 14, 2012). ''Pokémon Dream Radar'' is a shooting game that uses the Nintendo 3DS camera and gyro sensor. Find, shoot and capture Pokémon that appear in real space. (June 23, 2012)}} ==Release information== This card was included in the {{TCG|Dragons Exalted}} expansion, first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Dragon Blast}} expansion and {{TCG|Hydreigon Half Deck}}. It was later reprinted in Japan as part of the {{TCG|Master Deck Build Box EX}}, released on September 14, 2012. As part of the {{TCG|Pokémon League}} Player Rewards for the 2011-2012 season, a special Crosshatch Holofoil version of this card was distributed to players who earned enough Play! Points to qualify for Tier 2 rewards. This card's Dragon Blast regular print was also included in the {{TCG|Pokémon Card Game 25th Anniversary Creatures Deck}}, a commemorative {{TCG|Half Deck}} given to [[Creatures, Inc.]] illustrators and staff members to celebrate the [[Pokémon 25th Anniversary]] and the company's 26th. In this deck, this card represents the year 2012 of the company's history, and the back contains information about ''[[Pokédex 3D Pro]]'' and ''[[Pokémon Dream Radar]]''. This card has a "25th" stamp next to the illustration, and keeps the original set symbol, rarity, and collection number. ===Gallery=== {{TCGGallery |type=Colorless |class=Special |image1=BlendEnergyGRPDDragonsExalted117.jpg |set1=Dragons Exalted |illus1=5ban Graphics |image2=BlendEnergyGRPDCreaturesDeck back.jpg |caption2=Back (Creatures Deck print only) }} ==Trivia== ===Origin=== ==In other languages== {{Langtable|color={{TCG Colorless color}}|bordercolor={{TCG Colorless color dark}} |ja=ブレンドエネルギー{{e|Grass}}{{e|Fire}}{{e|Psychic}}{{e|Darkness}} (ブレンドエネルギー 草炎超悪) ''Blend Energy Kusa Honō Chō Aku'' |zh_yue= |zh_cmn= |fr=Énergie Amalgamée {{e|Grass}}{{e|Fire}}{{e|Psychic}}{{e|Darkness}} (Énergie Amalgamée Plante Feu Psy Obscurité) |de=Allerlei-Energie {{e|Grass}}{{e|Fire}}{{e|Psychic}}{{e|Darkness}} (Allerlei-Energie Pflanze Feu Psycho Finsternis) |id= |it=Energia Fusione {{e|Grass}}{{e|Fire}}{{e|Psychic}}{{e|Darkness}} (Énergie Amalgamée Erba Fuoco Psico Oscurità) |ko=블렌드 에너지{{e|Grass}}{{e|Fire}}{{e|Psychic}}{{e|Darkness}} (블렌드 에너지 풀 불꽃 초 악) ''Blend Energy Pul Bulkkot Cho Ak'' |pt_br=Energia de Fusão {{e|Grass}}{{e|Fire}}{{e|Psychic}}{{e|Darkness}} (Energia de Fusão Planta Fogo Psíquica Escuridão) |es_la= |es_eu=Energía Combinada {{e|Grass}}{{e|Fire}}{{e|Psychic}}{{e|Darkness}} (Energía Combinada Planta Fuego Psíquico Oscura) |th= }} {{Project TCG notice}} [[Category:Energy cards that provide more than one type of Energy]] [[Category:Dragons Exalted cards]] [[Category:Dragon Blast cards]] [[Category:Hydreigon Half Deck cards]] [[Category:Master Deck Build Box EX cards]] [[Category:Creatures Deck cards]] [[Category:Illus. by 5ban Graphics]] [[Category:Holographic cards]] [[de:Allerlei-Energie PFPF (TCG)]] [[es:Energía Combinada PFPO (TCG)]] [[fr:Énergie Amalgamée Plante Feu Psy Obscurité (Noir & Blanc Dragons Exaltés 117)]] [[it:Energia Fusione EFPO (Stirpe dei Draghi 117)]] [[ja:ブレンドエネルギー 草炎超悪]] [[zh:混合能量 草火超恶（TCG）]]
